{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bakura Incident''', also known as the '''Bakura Campaign''', was the name given to the series of battles in the [[Bakura system/Legends|Bakura system]], that began the day after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and would last a single week. The campaign consisted of the [[Invasion of Bakura]], the [[Bakura Truce]], and the [[Battle of Bakura]].
